decisions: Use compact Uint32Array offsets (4 bytes per UTF16 offset); retain surrogate-interior rejection with a sentinel. This adopts original Flow storage rather than per-character Map while preserving current strict source descriptor binding.

Build one source-bound index and ranged element per query, replay all linked ancestors iteratively against captured bytes and compare complete reconstructed receipt JSON. No received digest is trusted as sufficient proof.

Exact incremental serialized output admission counts immutable metadata, source text escaping, complete/cursor/interval fields, range wrappers/references, match entries and separators before retaining each candidate. Unique windows are counted once and reused.

Keep current JSON layout/sourceRevision/receipt identities, 2MiB limit, typed error and final serialization check. Preserve index/routes/bounds/digest, read-only authority and canonical snapshot storage.

The existing SourceCaptureBudget owns captured files/manifests and read bytes; the query output collector owns one generated query receipt and its dynamic window/match arrays. It is a separate contract within the existing values module.
measurementNotes: Clean time/RSS probes run without enumeration/index instrumentation; counters are recorded in separate processes. Times and process high-water RSS are environment-dependent observations, not pass/fail thresholds.

Original Flow receipt layout and its receipt validation differ; semantic matches/windows agree. The current full receipt content/auth is preserved and exact receipt JSON is compared before and after this correction.

Old original output charges a smaller receipt representation; its 4151-range threshold is not imposed on the current complete receipt layout. Current format reaches its exact serialized limit at candidate2985.
